question: Is the independent voltage failure a frozen amplitude/bias calibration error, an activity-imbalanced objective, or a representation-generalization failure?

calibration.source: seventh connected component of every train regime

audit.source: eighth connected component of every train regime

selection_rule.primary_metric: median eight-ms voltage RMSE divided by persistence RMSE on calibration
selection_rule.constraint: positive eight-ms STATE gain versus persistence in every seed

audit_strata.activity_measure: absolute teacher endpoint voltage change at eight milliseconds
audit_strata.region_breakdown: every canonical teacher region, reported without influencing selection

decision_rule.FROZEN_VOLTAGE_CALIBRATION_RESCUES_GENER: the sealed audit beats persistence in every seed with at least 2% median voltage gain, positive STATE gain in every seed, zero physical voltage violations, and uses a material amplitude or bias correction
decision_rule.ACTIVITY_IMBALANCED_VOLTAGE_OBJECTIVE: the aggregate active stratum beats persistence by at least 2% while the quiescent stratum remains worse than persistence

prohibited: changing candidate selection after reading the audit role
using the audit role for fitting the bias
